title: Biological treatment
summary: Enzymes or microorganisms are used to break down or modify the butt material over hours or days. It is the least developed family: no commercial process, no pilot-scale demonstration and no located evidence of full-butt biological recycling at any scale.
mechanism: Enzymes such as esterases and deacetylases, or fungal and bacterial cultures, act on the butt under controlled temperature, acidity, moisture and aeration, with the aim of partly deacetylating the cellulose acetate or degrading the paper and tobacco fraction. The treated material is then separated from the biological medium, washed and dried.
feedstock: Spent cigarette butts, possibly shredded, dried or sterilised first. No located source states a mass basis for the butt feed.
preparation: Collection, and optional shredding, drying or sterilisation before the biological stage.

steps.label: Collection and pre-treatment
steps.description: Butts are collected and may be shredded, dried or sterilised before treatment. No located source states a preparation protocol.

steps.label: Biological treatment
steps.description: Enzymes or microorganisms act on the material under controlled conditions of temperature, acidity, moisture and aeration. No located source states an enzyme type or dose, a microbial strain, an incubation time, a temperature, an acidity or a nutrient formulation. The use of some organisms or enzymes is subject to biosafety and containment rules that any later trial would have to respect.

steps.label: Separation and recovery
steps.description: Treated material is separated from the biological medium by filtration or centrifugation, and any recovered cellulose or cellulose-acetate derivative is washed and dried.

steps.label: Residual handling
steps.description: The spent biological medium contains degraded components, nutrients and any metals that were carried into it, and it requires a disposal route that has not been located.

inputs.label: Spent cigarette butts
inputs.description: Butts as the substrate for the biological stage.

inputs.label: Enzymes or microbial cultures
inputs.description: The biological agent used to deacetylate or degrade the material. No located source names a strain or an enzyme for this feedstock.

inputs.label: Nutrient medium, where growth is required
inputs.description: Medium for microbial growth, where the route uses living cultures.

streams.label: Wash water from the recovered material

products.label: Treated butt material
products.description: Partly deacetylated cellulose acetate, partly degraded cellulose or treated butt material, depending on the biological route. The degree of change, the purity and the residual toxicity are not established.
products.intendedUse: No use is established. No product standard accepts biologically treated material from this source and no located source demonstrates performance in any application.

sinks.material: Biologically treated butt material, with an unestablished degree of change and unestablished residual contamination.
sinks.intendedUse: None established by any located source.
sinks.acceptanceBasis: Not established. No product standard, purity specification or contamination limit has been located for biologically treated material.
sinks.issuer: Not established. No company, standard body or authority has been located as the issuer of an accepted product.
sinks.finalRoute: Not established. The spent biological medium has no demonstrated disposal route in any located source.

organizations.name: Korean patent holder for KR10-1782684-1
organizations.role: Holder of a granted Korean patent for a device that treats cigarette butts microbially, described through a trade-press reference rather than a located patent text.

claims.title: A granted Korean patent describes a device for microbial treatment of cigarette butts
claims.proposition: A patent granted in South Korea describes a device for treating cigarette butts with microorganisms.

claims.title: It is not known whether biological treatment degrades or concentrates the contaminants
claims.proposition: No located source reports whether nicotine, tar components or heavy metals are degraded, transformed or simply concentrated by a biological treatment of cigarette butts.

claims.title: Heavy metals are not destroyed by a biological process
claims.proposition: No located source describes a biological step that removes heavy metals from cigarette butt material, and the fate of those metals between the treated material and the spent medium has not been reported.

claims.title: The extent of change to the cellulose acetate is unknown
claims.proposition: No located source quantifies how far cellulose acetate from cigarette butts can be deacetylated or degraded, and no located source demonstrates complete mineralisation.

claims.title: No jurisdiction-specific regulatory status has been located for this family
claims.proposition: No located source names a jurisdiction, a material status, an acceptance pathway or an authority for this family, so the regulatory position of the recovered material remains unlocated.

claims.title: This family is at an earlier stage than the others
claims.proposition: Because the located evidence for this family is a single granted patent for a treatment device together with general literature on polymer biodegradation that was not written about cigarette butts, this family has a weaker basis for any claim than the families with a peer-reviewed study behind them.
claims.reasoning: The one located source establishes that a device has been patented, not that the approach works on this feedstock. The general biodegradation literature is not about cigarette butts and cannot be transferred without a measurement. The comparison is therefore made against the evidence each family actually has, and it favours the others.

gaps.title: No degradation study exists for cigarette butts under biological treatment
gaps.question: When cigarette butts are treated biologically, are the nicotine and the combustion residues degraded into harmless products, transformed into something else, or simply moved into the spent medium?
gaps.whyItMatters: The three answers lead to completely different routes. A process that degrades the residues is a treatment; a process that moves them into the liquid has produced a contaminated effluent that needs its own solution; a process that leaves them in the solid has achieved nothing for product purposes.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: A measurement of the named analytes in the input material, in the spent medium and in the treated solid, on one dry-mass basis, would distinguish the three answers.

gaps.title: Metals may be concentrated into the spent medium
gaps.question: If metals are carried into the biological medium rather than destroyed, does the medium then hold a concentrated metal load that has to go somewhere?
gaps.whyItMatters: A biological route can concentrate a hazard while appearing to break it down, and the concentration would then sit in an effluent stream that is easier to overlook than solid residue.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: Measuring metals in the spent medium against the input material on the same basis would show whether concentration occurs.

gaps.title: Biological routes carry containment obligations that chemical routes do not
gaps.question: What does the choice of a living or enzyme system add to the obligations of any later trial?
gaps.whyItMatters: A route description that names a biological agent without naming the containment and disposal obligations attached to it would make an untested family look ready for a trial when it is not.
assumptions: Any later trial would use a living culture or an enzyme preparation.
The treated material would need to be handled and the spent medium disposed of under rules that apply to biological agents.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: If a located source documented a specific containment and disposal regime that applies to this feedstock, this note would become a requirement to satisfy rather than an open question.

assessments.title: Evidence strength for biological treatment
assessments.label: Minimal
assessments.rationale: The located support is a granted patent for a device and general literature on polymer biodegradation that was not written about cigarette butts. No directly relevant support for this feedstock was located, and the search boundary was recorded, which is what the lowest band describes.

assessments.title: Process ease for biological treatment
assessments.label: Difficult
assessments.rationale: The route needs a controlled biological stage running over hours or days, with temperature, acidity, moisture and aeration control, separation from the medium and the disposal of a contaminated spent medium. That is a specialised operation with real dependencies, which places it in the difficult band.

assessments.title: Resource burden for biological treatment
assessments.unknownReason: No located source reports incubation time, aeration energy, water or medium consumption on a stated functional unit, and no comparable denominator exists across the families, so this criterion stays unknown.

assessments.title: Contaminant fate coverage for biological treatment
assessments.label: Minimal
assessments.rationale: No degradation study and no per-analyte partitioning data has been located, so neither the decision-relevant analytes nor the major output streams have been measured. The streams are named but their contents are not known.

assessments.title: Sink completeness for biological treatment
assessments.label: Undefined
assessments.rationale: No final treatment route for the spent biological medium has been defined at all, and no acceptance basis or issuer has been located for the treated material, so the produced material and its final route are both unnamed.

assessments.title: Product readiness for biological treatment
assessments.label: Undefined
assessments.rationale: The treated material has not been characterised for purity, degree of change or residual toxicity, and no product gate has been located, so there is no product performance evidence to judge.

assessments.title: Regulatory clarity for biological treatment
assessments.label: Unlocated
assessments.rationale: No jurisdiction, material status or authority has been located for this family, and the biosafety obligations attached to the biological agent are a separate matter from any end-of-waste status.

assessments.title: Validation maturity for biological treatment
assessments.label: Foundational unknowns
assessments.rationale: Whether the route degrades the contaminants at all is unknown, and the extent of change to the polymer is unquantified, so the mechanism itself needs basic resolution before a bounded programme could be defined.

gapNotes: No published protocol specifies enzyme types, dosages, microbial strains, incubation times, temperatures, acidity values or nutrient formulations for this family. Those parameters are inventor choices, not measured reference values.
No degradation study exists for cigarette butts under biological treatment. Whether nicotine, tar components or heavy metals are degraded, transformed or simply concentrated is unknown.
No energy or water consumption data exists for this family. Incubation duration and aeration energy are major unknowns.
Biologically treated material has not been characterised for purity, degree of change or residual toxicity, and no product standard accepts it.
No regulatory pathway has been identified for this material. Biosafety requirements for enzymes and microorganisms would have to be addressed.
No cost data exists for this family. Agent cost, incubation time and yield would dominate the operating economics, and all are unmeasured.
Evidence for this family is limited to general polymer-biodegradation literature and one granted patent. No independent verification of cigarette-butt-specific performance exists.
This family cannot close a four-field sink with the evidence located so far. All four fields are open.

fourField.dryMassBalance: Unknown - no mass-balance data has been published for this family.
fourField.analyteFate: Unknown - no per-analyte degradation or partitioning data has been published for this family.
fourField.treatmentRoute: Not defined - no biological treatment route for cigarette butts has been defined, and the spent medium has no disposal route.
fourField.productGate: Not set - no product acceptance criteria have been established for the treated material.

title: Material incorporation into other products
summary: Butt material is added to another material as a partial replacement, in bricks, concrete, tiles, asphalt, panels or insulation. It is conceptually simple, and the contaminants stay with the butts.
mechanism: Butt material is physically incorporated into a host matrix at a stated rate, mixed, formed and then cured or fired. The butts are not chemically changed; the contaminants travel with them into the product, and may leach from it or volatilise during firing.
feedstock: Dried cigarette butts, optionally milled or washed, combined with a host matrix such as clay, cement, aggregate, asphalt binder or polymer resin. No located source states the incorporation rate as a percentage of mass or volume, and no located source states a mass basis.
preparation: Drying, and optionally milling or washing the butt material before it is mixed into the matrix.

steps.label: Pre-treatment of the butt material
steps.description: The butt material is dried and optionally milled or washed. No located source states a particle size distribution or a preparation protocol.

steps.label: Matrix preparation
steps.description: The host matrix is prepared in the usual way for the product being made, such as a clay mix, a concrete mix or an asphalt binder.

steps.label: Incorporation
steps.description: The butt material is added to the matrix at a stated rate. No located source states the rate as a percentage of mass or volume for any product.

steps.label: Forming, curing and firing
steps.description: The blend is formed into the product and then cured, fired or cooled. Where butt material is fired, the located source material records warn that volatile compounds would be released to the air and that emission controls would be needed.

steps.label: End of life
steps.description: No located source names a route for a product that contains butt material when it is demolished or discarded, and demolition waste containing butt material would need separate handling.

inputs.label: Prepared butt material
inputs.description: Dried, and optionally milled or washed, butt material used as a partial raw-material replacement.

inputs.label: Host matrix materials
inputs.description: Clay, cement, aggregate, asphalt binder or polymer resin, depending on the product.

products.label: Bricks, concrete, tiles, asphalt and panels containing butt material
products.description: Construction and composite products in which butt material is used as a partial replacement for a conventional raw material.
products.intendedUse: Construction and, in some reported cases, outdoor products. No located source demonstrates fitness for a load-bearing application, and no product standard accepts butt material as an ingredient.

sinks.material: Construction and composite products containing cigarette butt material at an incorporation rate that no located source states.
sinks.intendedUse: Construction materials and, in some reported cases, outdoor products.
sinks.acceptanceBasis: Not established. No product standard, building-code provision, leaching limit or emission limit has been located for this material.
sinks.issuer: Not established. No company, standard body or authority has been located as the issuer of an accepted product.
sinks.finalRoute: Not established. No route for the finished product at end of life has been located, and demolition waste containing butt material would need separate handling.

claims.locator: Trade-press summary of the university study

claims.title: No located source demonstrates this family at commercial scale
claims.proposition: No located source demonstrates commercial-scale viability for a product containing cigarette butt material; the located studies are small in scale, and no independent verification of performance, safety or environmental benefit has been located.

claims.title: No located source reports leaching from a product containing butt material
claims.proposition: No located source reports whether contaminants leach from a finished product that contains butt material under weathering, rain or contact with water and soil, and no located source reports the emissions from firing butt material.

claims.title: Heavy metals are carried into the product in this family
claims.proposition: No located source describes a step in this family that would remove heavy metals, and no located source reports the heavy-metal content of a finished product or its leaching potential.

claims.title: No jurisdiction-specific regulatory status has been located for this family
claims.proposition: No located source names a jurisdiction, a material status, an acceptance pathway or an authority for this family, so the regulatory position of the recovered material remains unlocated.

claims.title: The claimed energy saving cannot be compared across this family
claims.proposition: Because the located study reports an energy comparison without stating the functional unit, the boundary and the butt inclusion rate on a common basis, its energy saving cannot be compared with any other product in this family.
claims.reasoning: An energy claim only compares if the system boundary, the functional unit and the inclusion rate are stated. The located report gives none of them, and no other product in the family has a comparable figure. The claim is therefore recorded as reported and marked as not comparable, rather than repeated as a benefit.

gaps.title: Do the contaminants stay inside the product for its whole life
gaps.question: When butt material is built into a brick, a panel or a road surface, do the contaminants stay inside the product for its whole life, or do they leach out or volatilise during firing and use?
gaps.whyItMatters: This family makes the contamination less visible rather than smaller. If the contaminants leave the product slowly, then a product sold as a partial raw-material replacement is a slow source of the same substances that made butt litter a problem in the first place.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: A leaching study on a product containing butt material, together with emission measurements for any firing step, would show whether the contaminants remain contained.

gaps.title: At what rate can the material be added without weakening the product
gaps.question: What incorporation rate can butt material be added at before the mechanical performance of the product falls below what its use requires?
gaps.whyItMatters: The rate is the trade-off between diverting waste and producing a usable product. Without it, the family cannot be judged on either side: it is neither a proven waste solution nor a proven product.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: Mechanical testing across a range of stated incorporation rates against a stated product requirement would either establish a usable rate or show that none exists.

gaps.title: This family relocates a waste stream without treating it
gaps.question: Should this family be described as treating cigarette butts?
gaps.whyItMatters: The butt material reaches the product with its contaminants intact. Calling that treatment would imply that the contamination was dealt with, when what actually happened is that it was given a different and less visible form.
assumptions: No treatment step precedes the incorporation in this family.
The product is used in circumstances where leaching or contact is possible, which construction and road applications generally are.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: If a located source demonstrated that the contaminants are immobilised to a defined standard before incorporation, the description could change from relocation to treatment.

assessments.title: Evidence strength for material incorporation
assessments.label: Limited
assessments.rationale: The located support is a small number of small-scale studies and trade-press reports, with no independent verification of performance, safety or environmental benefit at commercial scale. There is directly relevant support, but it is narrow in scale and coverage, which is the limited band.

assessments.title: Process ease for material incorporation
assessments.label: Moderate
assessments.rationale: Mixing, forming, curing and firing are established operations that a brick or concrete producer already owns, but the incorporation step adds a variable material whose effect on the product is not yet known, which keeps the route out of the easy bands.

assessments.title: Resource burden for material incorporation
assessments.unknownReason: No located source reports water, energy or processing cost on a stated functional unit for any product in this family, and the one reported energy comparison does not state its boundary, so this criterion stays unknown.

assessments.title: Contaminant fate coverage for material incorporation
assessments.label: Minimal
assessments.rationale: The contaminants are not removed by this family and no leaching, firing-emission or end-of-life study has been located, so the named analytes and the major output streams are unmeasured.

assessments.title: Sink completeness for material incorporation
assessments.label: Proposed
assessments.rationale: The incorporation route and the intended construction use are named, but no acceptance basis and no issuer have been located, and the route for the finished product at end of life is undefined.

assessments.title: Product readiness for material incorporation
assessments.label: Undefined
assessments.rationale: No mechanical testing data, no leaching behaviour and no product gate have been located for a product of this kind, so there is no product performance evidence to judge.

assessments.title: Regulatory clarity for material incorporation
assessments.label: Unlocated
assessments.rationale: No jurisdiction, material status or authority has been located for this family. Building codes, product rules, leaching limits and emission permits would all have to be checked for the specific jurisdiction and product, and none of them has been.

assessments.title: Validation maturity for material incorporation
assessments.label: Foundational unknowns
assessments.rationale: Two basics are unresolved at once: whether the contaminants stay in the product, and at what rate the material can be added without weakening it. Both are foundational, so the next human work is basic resolution rather than a bounded confirmation.

No cost data exists for this family. The value of the butt material as a partial raw-material replacement against the processing cost is unknown.

title: Where the recovered material could go
summary: A survey of the end products that recovered butt material could be routed into. It is not a process of its own: it maps the outputs of the other families onto candidate products.
mechanism: There is no mechanism here. Each of the other families produces a different intermediate, and this page lists where each intermediate could plausibly go. Every route inherits the contaminants of the intermediate it starts from, so a route only removes contaminants when it is paired with a washing or dissolution family.
feedstock: Not a single feedstock. The inputs are the intermediates of the other families: washed fibre, milled particles, recovered polymer, partly deacetylated cellulose, and an incorporated composite.
preparation: Each route would need its own preparation, from the intermediate it starts with to the finished article.

steps.label: Construction materials
steps.description: Milled particles or ash mixed into clay, concrete, tile or asphalt. The located evidence is a small number of small-scale studies, and no located source demonstrates commercial scale.

steps.label: Composite profiles
steps.description: Butt particles blended with a thermoplastic resin and formed into outdoor furniture, bollards, decking and construction profiles. The located evidence is company claim without independent performance or lifecycle data.

steps.label: Textiles and nonwovens
steps.description: Recovered polymer or partly deacetylated cellulose used to make fibre for textiles and nonwoven products. The located patent literature describes dissolving the polymer; no located study covers cigarette-butt-specific textile products.

steps.label: Films and membranes
steps.description: Recovered polymer used for films and membranes for packaging, filtration and separation. The located evidence is general polymer literature, with no cigarette-butt-specific study located.

steps.label: Insulation and acoustic panels
steps.description: Butt fibre or composite material used for insulation boards or acoustic panels. No located source specific to cigarette butts has been found for this route, and the flammability of the material is unresolved.

steps.label: Energy recovery
steps.description: Butts burned with energy capture. The flue gas carries nicotine, tar and metals and the ash holds concentrated residues, so this route is energy recovery rather than material recycling, and it would need air-quality permits.

inputs.label: Intermediates from the other families
inputs.description: Washed fibre, milled particles, recovered polymer, partly deacetylated cellulose or an incorporated composite.

streams.label: Finished articles of each candidate route

products.label: Candidate finished articles
products.description: Bricks and road materials, composite profiles, textile fibre, films and membranes, insulation and acoustic panels, and energy recovery. None has an independent evidence base for safety, performance or environmental benefit.
products.intendedUse: Each route names a use, and none of them has a located product standard, product gate or regulatory pathway that accepts it.

sinks.material: Materials derived from recovered butt material, in a state whose contaminant content has not been established.
sinks.intendedUse: Construction, textiles, membranes, insulation and energy recovery, depending on the route.
sinks.acceptanceBasis: Not established. No product standard, building code or regulatory pathway accepts cigarette butt material for any of these routes.
sinks.issuer: Not established. No company, standard body or authority has been located as the issuer of an accepted product.
sinks.finalRoute: Not established. Only the energy-recovery route has a nominal final form, and its ash has no located route either.

claims.title: Cigarette butt material mixed into asphalt has been reported
claims.proposition: A technical article describes mixing cigarette butt material into asphalt to make a road material.

claims.title: No route has independent evidence of safety, performance or environmental benefit
claims.proposition: No candidate route located for this family has independent evidence of safety, performance or environmental benefit, and all of them remain unvalidated hypotheses.

claims.title: Heavy metals must be measured before any route is considered
claims.proposition: No located source reports the heavy-metal content of any candidate product from this family or its leaching potential, and no route can be considered until that measurement exists.

claims.title: No jurisdiction-specific regulatory status has been located for this family
claims.proposition: No located source names a jurisdiction, a material status, an acceptance pathway or an authority for this family, so the regulatory position of the recovered material remains unlocated.

claims.title: A route inherits the contaminants of the intermediate it starts from
claims.proposition: Because every route in this family takes material from another family without a step of its own, each route inherits the contaminant content of that intermediate, and only a route paired with a washing or dissolution family removes anything at all.
claims.reasoning: The two located route descriptions show material moving from an intermediate into an article, with no treatment step of their own. A route therefore cannot be cleaner than its input. This is why the family is presented as a survey of destinations rather than as a family of methods.

gaps.title: No candidate route has a product gate
gaps.question: If any of these routes were to be pursued, which one would be judged first, against which stated product requirement, in which jurisdiction?
gaps.whyItMatters: A route can only be assessed once the intended product and the jurisdiction are fixed, because the acceptance criteria depend on what the article is for and where it is sold. Without that, every route looks equally unproven and none can be prioritised on evidence.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: Stating a jurisdiction and an intended use for one route, and locating the acceptance basis that applies to it, would let that route be assessed and would leave the others waiting on the same decision.

gaps.title: Energy recovery is a different proposition from material recovery
gaps.question: Should the energy-recovery route be counted as a recycling route at all, given that it destroys the material and concentrates the metals into ash?
gaps.whyItMatters: Counting it would inflate the apparent number of options available, because it does not deliver any recovered material and it leaves a residue that still has to be routed.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: If a located source showed that the ash from this route had an accepted outlet under a stated standard, the route could be presented as a complete option rather than as energy recovery with a residue problem.

gaps.title: Choosing a route does not choose a clean product
gaps.question: How should a reader weigh the candidate routes against each other?
gaps.whyItMatters: The routes differ in what they are made from and in where they are sold, not in how clean they are. Presenting them as a set of options without saying so would let a reader assume that one of them avoids the contaminant problem.
assumptions: Each route is proposed to use the intermediate from another family without an intervening treatment step.
No located source describes a route-specific contaminant reduction.
gaps.falsifierOrDecisionCondition: If a located source described a treatment step specific to one route that measurably reduced the contaminant load, that route would have to be presented separately from the others.

assessments.title: Evidence strength for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Minimal
assessments.rationale: For most routes no cigarette-butt-specific source was located at all, and for the two with located sources the support is a news report and a technical article rather than independent performance evidence. The search boundary was recorded, which is what the lowest band describes.

assessments.title: Process ease for the candidate product routes
assessments.unknownReason: This family is a survey of end-product destinations rather than a single process, so process ease is a property of each route and of the family that supplies its input, and it cannot be scored for the family as a whole.

assessments.title: Resource burden for the candidate product routes
assessments.unknownReason: No located source reports water, energy or cost on a stated functional unit for any candidate route, and the routes do not share a functional unit between them, so this criterion stays unknown.

assessments.title: Contaminant fate coverage for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Minimal
assessments.rationale: Every route inherits the contaminants of its input intermediate, and no located source measures the content of any candidate product, its flue gas or its ash, so nothing about the fate of the named analytes has been measured.

assessments.title: Sink completeness for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Undefined
assessments.rationale: For most routes no final treatment route has been defined at all, and none of the routes has a located acceptance basis or issuer. The energy-recovery route has a nominal final form but its ash still has no route.

assessments.title: Product readiness for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Undefined
assessments.rationale: No product standard, product gate or performance evidence has been located for any candidate route, so there is no product performance evidence to judge in any of them.

assessments.title: Regulatory clarity for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Unlocated
assessments.rationale: No jurisdiction is named for any route, and no located source states a material status, an acceptance pathway or the air-quality permits that the energy-recovery route would need.

assessments.title: Validation maturity for the candidate product routes
assessments.label: Foundational unknowns
assessments.rationale: For every route the intended product, the jurisdiction and the acceptance basis are all still undecided, so the first human work is a decision about what would be judged, not a bounded test.
